_doc: Safety envelope enforced by the guard. min/max: absolute limits. max_step: largest change in one command. max_change_per_min: largest net change within any 60 s window (stops slow-ramp attacks). prediction: the digital twin simulates horizon_min ahead and blocks commands that would push the water outside these bands. Edit via the dashboard (engineer PIN) or here.

chlorine_dose.reason: dose cap; the residual itself (EPA max 4.0 mg/L) is checked by the twin

naoh_dose.reason: lye overdose pushes pH above the EPA 6.5-8.5 range

distribution_rate.reason: sudden flow changes cause pressure surges (water hammer)

distribution_pump.reason: stopping it cuts water to the town

interlocks.message: can't stop distribution while clearwell is above 90% (overflow risk)
can't stop intake while clearwell is below 15% (town runs dry)

_doc_max_large_reversals_per_hour: Swings of at least half a max step that reverse direction more than this many times in an hour are refused (slow pump cycling).

lockdown._doc: After this many refused commands from one source within window_min, that source may only make changes the twin forecasts as corrective, until an operator clears it on the console. Simulated operators were refused at most 3 times in a 12-hour shift.

_doc_lab_inputs: Twin inputs the PLC doesn't measure, entered from lab grab samples: e.g. {"raw_alkalinity": {"max_age_h": 36}}. Older than max_age_h: twin chemistry pauses (static rules only) and the operator is alerted. python -m aegis.labinputs set raw_alkalinity 74 --by NAME

safe_hold._doc: If the twin forecasts unsafe water and nobody acknowledges for after_min, restore the earlier value (within lookback_min) that fixes the forecast most, and hold it for hold_min (only corrective changes until released on the dashboard). An acknowledgement pauses it for ack_valid_min. Never acts in monitor mode or while the integrity monitor distrusts the sensors.

_doc_unknown_writers: gateway (route mode): 'block' makes every host not named in --sources read-only. Recommended once the writers are known.
